title: Worth the Risk
briefing: Nimbus Cloud is pulling back in an uptrend. Pebble Games has run up a long way. Compare reward with risk before you pick a trade.
objective: Measure trades in R. Take setups with at least 2:1 reward-to-risk; skip the rest.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud dipped for five days inside its uptrend, giving a nearby stop and a distant target: a good reward-to-risk setup. It resumed climbing, helped by new clients on day 14. Pebble Games had already run far, so the nearest sensible stop was a long way below and the upside was small. On day 10 it gapped down on a game delay. Picking the better ratio mattered.
